integrity: The result is derived from explicit diagram multiplication and a proven interval-packing recurrence; finite checks in verify.py are supplementary.
scientific_limitations: Only the rank n-2 idempotent stratum is treated. Already known rank-stratum classification is a premise, not an original conclusion. Theorem counts compatible subsets rather than distinct generated subsemigroups. Possible equivalent published interval-packing formulation has not been eliminated. Independent audit is not performed.
title: The commuting-clique polynomial of corank-two Jones idempotents
